protocol.first_fresh_process_pair: Retain separately and exclude from percentiles. File page-cache state uncontrolled.
protocol.order: Alternate old/new order each measured pair; case0 beginsold,case1 beginsnew, and so on. No concurrently timed processes.
protocol.rss: wait4 command high-water RSS, normalized to bytes; compute median,p95,max separately. Main values exclude harness and are not simultaneous tree sums.
protocol.latency: Whole fresh CLI subprocess including startup and output writing; p50 median, p95 nearest rank.
protocol.outputs: Remove each expected output before execution. Full collapsed stack/count maps and complete heatmap timeline/stack/count plus used ID/RGB/digest after every first,warmup,measured and separate tree pair, outside all timed intervals.
protocol.retention: Atomic raw JSON checkpoint after every command and verification, including failure metrics/status; no retries,outlier removal or changedN after observing results.
protocol.artifacts: Read-only baseline/candidate executable copies, existing trusted SHA input pool only; per-case aliases never link mutable originals. Do not duplicate large inputs.
protocol.isolation: Root grants exclusive CPU slot after all compilers,profilers and tests finish. Stop before insufficient disk headroom.
protocol.comparison: Ratios old/new:>1 means candidate faster; positive RSS reduction means lower candidate RSS. Publish all six cases, including unchanged/noisy/loss cells.
protocol.tree_RSS: Five extra RSS-only pairs for limited batch, excluded from timing percentiles; sample PID/PPID/RSS only; disclose shared-page double count and missed short-lived children.
